name: AcVerticalAnchor
description: Used with the VerticalAnchor property to specify how a control is anchored vertically within its layout.

constants.name: acVerticalAnchorTop
constants.description: The control is anchored at the top of its layout.

constants.name: acVerticalAnchorBottom
constants.description: The control is anchored at the bottom of its layout.

constants.name: acVerticalAnchorBoth
constants.description: The control is stretched vertically across its layout.
